abstract: An enzyme immunoassay (EIA) for hCG-beta CTP was newly developed. Anti hCG-beta CTP antibody was prepared from antiserum to the synthetic peptide corresponding to the carboxyl terminal region by immunization of rabbits with hCG-beta subunit. Specimens to be tested were reacted with the antibody labelled with peroxidase and determined with a spectrophotometer after the addition of o-phenylenediamine. It was found that the sensitivity of the assay for hCG in sera was 0.2miu/ml and that values for the assay were significantly correlated with those for the RIA assay for hCG-beta (r = 0.916, Y = 1.27X + 1.8). Cross reactivity with LH, FSH, hCG-beta or hCG-alpha was observed to be 0.18%, 0.05%, 10.4% or less than 0.011% respectively. The assay has been applied in the management of hydatidiform mole, invasive mole and choriocarcinoma, indicating its usefulness because of the increase in sensitivity roughly 25 times or 10 times as great as hemagglutination or hCG-beta RIA assay.
abstract_ja: hCG-β CTPに対する酵素免疫測定法(EIA)を新たに開発した。カルボキシル末端領域に相当する合成ペプチドに対する抗血清から抗hCG-β CTP抗体を作製し、ウサギをhCG-βサブユニットで免疫して得た。検体は、ペルオキシダーゼ標識抗体と反応させ、o-フェニレンジアミン添加後に分光光度計で測定した。血清中hCGに対する測定感度は0.2 mIU/mLであった。測定値はhCG-βのRIA法による測定値と有意に相関した(r = 0.916, Y = 1.27X + 1.8)。LH、FSH、hCG-βまたはhCG-αに対する交差反応性はそれぞれ0.18%、0.05%、10.4%、0.011%未満であった。本法は胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎および絨毛癌の管理に応用され、赤血球凝集法またはhCG-β RIA法と比べて感度がそれぞれ約25倍または10倍高く、有用性が示された。
